description: This file defines a test class for the GroupCountBased dispatcher in the FastRoute library. It extends a base DispatcherTest class and provides methods to specify the dispatcher and data generator classes used during testing.

classes.name: GroupCountBasedTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the GroupCountBased dispatcher in FastRoute.

methods.name: getDispatcherClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name for the dispatcher being tested, which is 'FastRoute\Dispatcher\GroupCountBased'.

methods.name: getDataGeneratorClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for the data generator used in tests, which is 'FastRoute\DataGenerator\GroupCountBased'.
